description: To check a SPECIFIC operation's status, call get_job with its operationId — this list only returns the most recent ops and may omit a just-started one. List recent Operations (the newer async-op system) for the active brand. Each operation has: id, kind, state (pending|running|completed|partially_failed|failed|cancelled), progress, result, errors. Use get_job with an operationId to poll a specific one. Filters: kind (e.g. seo_keyword_generate, seo_cluster_generate, lp_generate), state. Supports detail param: short=id+kind+state, medium=adds scopeId+progress+timestamps (no result/errors), full=raw including result.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

state.description: Filter by state: pending | running | completed | partially_failed | failed | cancelled

name: list_operations
